name: Audio Bitrate Presets
summary: Encodes audio using psychoacoustic models at target bitrates (Small: 96k, Balanced: 160k, High: 256k).
analogy: A sound engineer muting sounds that are drowned out by louder simultaneous instruments.
what_you_gain: Reduces audio size by 70-90% compared to raw WAV while sounding virtually indistinguishable to most listeners.
what_you_lose: Inaudible ultrasonic frequencies and masked harmonics are discarded permanently.
best_for: Voice recordings, podcasts, background music, sound effects, and casual listening.
avoid_for: Master studio stems intended for subsequent mixing, mastering, or frequency analysis.
go_deeper: Uses psychoacoustic masking models (AAC / MP3) to calculate the Absolute Threshold of Hearing and Modified Discrete Cosine Transform (MDCT).
